participant_rule: Every agent Playwright/Sims/UI adapter must enqueue instead of cancelling on human activity; await checkpoint before each side effect, maintain one cross-process desktop owner, and revalidate target before retry.
priority: Human input in any app, explicit operator override, or player-directed queue always blocks; absent/stale probe blocks; idle alone never overrides app-specific scene/save/consent or locks.
interruption: Do not cancel a queued task; no new UI effects until two fresh trusted idle probes >=15s. An active callback must cooperatively checkpoint between side effects. A result after human interruption requires reconciliation to avoid blind replay.
persistence: While caller session/process lives only; receipts contain IDs and states, never entered text or arbitrary URL; process restart requires rehydrating and revalidating intent. No background service installed.
lock: Global desktop file lock shared with per-Sims-PID host executors under ignored dist/host-listener; stale locks fail closed, never auto-stolen.
